module: Fence editing session of Easy Object Select. begin() discovers an existing fence from the selected object (fence/anchors) or starts a creation; the fence is represented by an editable spline (splineInput, sphere nodes) on which the populationEngine of meshSpline places TSStatic pieces as a preview (max 512). Committing creates/modifies the objects in a single undoable history action ("Edit Fence" or "Delete Fence").
usage:
local s = extensions.editor_ezObjectSelect_subtools_fence_session
local ok, err = s.begin({assetPaths = {"art/shapes/fence.dae"}, anchorDistance = 0.5, noOverlap = true})
-- every frame: s.update(true)
-- then: s.exitAndCommit()
notes: The Esc key cancels the session (update calls cancel).
On initial creation, a click on the terrain places the first node then dragging defines the second; a drag that is too short is ignored.
The final objects are added to editor.resolveAddGroup(MissionGroup) and the hook onEditorObjectAdded is emitted on restores (undo/redo).
exitAndCommit and deleteAndCommit refuse to act (return 0 and a message) if isCapped() is true.
Uses local upvalues: only one session can be active at a time.

begin.desc: Starts a session. Fails if a session is already active or if no asset is chosen. If objects are selected, starts from the last one; otherwise starts a blank creation. Saves the original selection and registers the spline tool.

options.desc: assetPaths (string[]), anchorDistance (m), noOverlap (boolean, true by default unless explicitly false).

update.desc: To be called every frame: handles Esc, the initial creation or spline editing, rebuilds the preview if the spline is modified and draws nodes and spline.

canAcceptInput.desc: true if input can be processed.

exitAndCommit.desc: Commits the fence: serializes the final state, ends the session and records the "Edit Fence" history action (undoable).

returns.desc: Number of pieces created; 0 if nothing or on error.

deleteAndCommit.desc: Deletes the fence's original objects in a single "Delete Fence" history action.

returns.desc: Number of pieces deleted; 0 if impossible.

cancel.desc: Cancels the session: restores the source objects and the original selection.

isActive.desc: true if a session is active.

isDragging.desc: true if a drag (initial creation or spline node) is in progress.

getSelectedPieceCount.desc: Number of original pieces selected at start.

getNodeCount.desc: Number of spline nodes (0 without a spline).

isLoop.desc: true if the spline is closed as a loop.

isCapped.desc: true if discovery or preview has reached the safety limit; committing is then blocked.

setNoOverlap.desc: Enables/disables the no-overlap mode (whole mesh lengths, remainder left empty at the end) and marks the spline for rebuilding.
